Ring Dips

Ring Dips is a arms exercise focused on Pectoralis major, Triceps brachii, Biceps brachii. You can review average reps and rep standards on one page.

Muscles worked

Group Muscles
Primary muscles Pectoralis major, Triceps brachii, Biceps brachii, Deltoids
Secondary muscles Latissimus dorsi
Stabilizers Rectus abdominis, External obliques, Trapezius
Grip Forearm flexors
